semantic_review.apply_penalty: Both unchanged selected seventeen-statement Python original and existing reciprocal candidate are independently checked against complete raw quotations. Every program-ID/metadata/arange/stride cast, source temporary, literal, mask, zero padding, count promotion, repetition comparison and store remains. Pointer/constexpr/call metadata stays outside the body, recording four FP32 buffers, actual signed INT32 IDs/counts/cumsum through the existing nonnegative logical channels, two runtime integer strides and the block constexpr. No generic mathematical stride range is narrowed and the existing native bounds/host checks remain. Unannotated Python stride parameters use mathematical integer metadata without a fixed native ABI claim; both original explicit INT64 value casts remain. The shared frontend routes a fresh dest=old+rhs through ordinary assignment inference so a later natural-valued load cannot retag an already signed offset. Its complete explicit-AST program, including inputs/output, both logical loads, address/mask and actual unsigned-store conversion, fails on prior code and passes after the fix; the 95 frontend and ten previous legacy regression roots all pass. No broad cast-inference override is reintroduced. Both complete FP executions are derived from the actual source and the original DIV-MUL-RCP domain/finite/nonzero premises are retained exactly. Full tagged-memory equality, failure/success, in-place store ordering, arbitrary repeated IDs in FP equivalence and exterior frame remain. Strict Nat/Int normalization connects the actual signed source to the independent mathematical memory observations and exact access-safety judgment; the prior false AST identity is removed without equating register states. Public Real IO and retained checked Tensor/whole-grid applications now use the canonical raw source. All 26 task roots replay, keeping Real active-write injectivity and the original native interpretation boundaries. The CPU probe uses the shared raw quotation checker before its existing bounded cast-erasing NumPy interpreter; 52 actual-wrapper/source controls pass. This is not native INT64-boundary/FMA conformance or a new numerical experiment. No selected Python JIT, public IO, input domain or numerical dependency changes.
